description: This is a JUnit test class for the StoppedKamonTimer class, testing its methods such as getName, getDuration, getTag, getTags, and reportDurationCorrectly. It uses Kamon metrics library and asserts behavior of timer operations.

classes.name: StoppedKamonTimerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing StoppedKamonTimer behavior and its interactions with Kamon metrics.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a StoppedTimer instance before each test.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Tests that the timer's name is correctly returned.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Tests that the timer duration is greater than zero nanoseconds.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a tag value from the timer.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Tests that the timer's tags contain exactly one key.

methods.name: reportDurationCorrectly
methods.description: Simulates a timer duration of approximately 1250ms, stops the timer, and asserts that the internally recorded maximum value exceeds 1 second.
